integrity: The center/blade neighborhood inequalities are derived exactly and the global center constraint is proved redundant only when blade order is at least three. Direct enumeration tests independent graph neighborhoods and formula counts.
scientific_limitations: Equal-size clique blades and at least two blades, each of size at least two.
Finite enumeration corroborates only bounded orders; all-parameter correctness is proved analytically.
The labeled palette count permits unused labels; surjective counts require inclusion-exclusion.
The founding paper covers complete graphs (the one-blade boundary), and a different majority notion covers friendship scalar examples.
title: Strong majority colorings of generalized windmills: a local-global transition
